tour_type.morning: 🏰 Bratislava Castle: * Begin with the city's best view — white castle walls, neat courtyards and a full panorama over the Danube. → | 🌳 Castle Hill Gardens: * Pleasant paths, quiet corners and great photo spots. → | 🏛️ St. Martin’s Cathedral: * Iconic Gothic church located right below the castle. → | ☕ Coffee in Old Town: * Cozy cafés with calm morning vibes.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Walk: * Narrow medieval streets, pastel façades and charming squares. → | 🗿 Cumil ‘Man at Work’: * Fun city mascot statue — a must for a quick photo. → | 🧭 Michael’s Gate: * The last preserved medieval gate with a cool tower. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Slovak Specialties: * Try halušky-style dishes, soups, dumplings or veggie options.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Promenade or UFO Bridge Viewing Path: * Warm sky, river reflections and the perfect chill moment above the water.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old-Town Evening Walk or Riverbank Chill: * Gentle nighttime strolls, dessert cafés, calm squares and safe relaxed vibes.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Bratislava Castle → Castle Hill Gardens → St. Martin’s Cathedral → Coffee; Afternoon: Old Town → Cumil statue → Michael’s Gate → Lunch; Sunset: Danube promenade or UFO viewpoint area; Night: Old-town dessert cafés or riverside walk

ideas: ☕ Outdoor cafés around the old town
🌳 Shaded walks in Sad Janka Kráľa (one of Europe's oldest parks)
🏛️ Museum days (City Museum, Danubiana Art Museum)

places: 🏰 Bratislava Castle: | Historic fortress with panoramic river and city views.
⛪ St. Martin’s Cathedral: | Gothic structure tied to centuries of coronation history.
🏛️ Michael’s Gate: | A medieval tower giving a look into the city’s old defenses.
what_to_get: 📜 Historical Postcards: | Old-town sketches, castle scenes, cathedral artwork.
🏰 Mini Castle Replicas: | Small keepsakes inspired by Bratislava Castle.

places: 🖼️ Danubiana Meulensteen Art Museum: | Modern art on a peninsula surrounded by water.
🎨 Nedbalka Gallery: | Unique circular architecture with Slovak art collections.
🗿 Public Sculptures: | Famous city statues (Cumil, Paparazzi, Napoleonic soldier).
what_to_get: 🖨️ Art Prints: | Modern Slovak designs or illustrations of bridges and rooftops.
🎭 Handmade Crafts: | Clay items, woodwork and artistic souvenirs.

places: 🍽️ Slovak Restaurants (non-alcoholic friendly): | Soups, dumplings, potato dishes and sweet pastries.
🥨 Old-Town Bakeries: | Fresh rolls, cakes and warm treats.
☕ Riverside Cafés: | Chill spots ideal for dessert and scenic views.
what_to_get: 🍫 Local Chocolate: | Creative Slovakia-themed bars and flavors.
🍰 Packaged Pastries: | Soft Slovak baked souvenirs safe to bring home.

places: 📸 Castle Terrace: | Rooftop-like panorama of the Danube and bridges.
🌉 Old Town Streets: | Pastel walls, lanterns, cobblestone patterns.
🌅 UFO Bridge Area: | Evening shots with reflections on the river.
what_to_get: 🖼️ Photography Prints: | Classic Bratislava skyline views.
📬 Illustrated Postcards: | Cute art versions of Cumil, castle and old-town corners.
